description: One slot and one checkpoint whose anchored_head (and the anchor entry) was computed over the v3 genesis. Under r6 (v3 genesis) the v2-chained journal fails with HEAD_MISMATCH at the checkpoint line; the v3-chained journal has no finding but CANDLE_LAG_UNSET (r5 reports the opposite for each: the genesis differs).
title: the same journal chained from the v3 genesis
